assertions.name: chiral channel = trefoil T_(2,3) has Seifert genus 1
ζ₅ carrier = cinquefoil T_(2,5) has Seifert genus 2
trefoil and cinquefoil are distinct (genera differ)
quadratic Gauss sum over ℤ₅-orbit squares to 5 (g²=5)

description: Ties the H₂S Bring 1/√5 geometry together: the chiral channel is the trefoil T_(2,3) (Seifert genus 1, the color-tube cubic's B₃↠H₃ monodromy) and the ζ₅ carrier is the cinquefoil T_(2,5) (genus 2, the hyperelliptic quintic 𝒳₅:y²=x⁵−1 embedded via the first Lagrange resolvent w₁ of ℤ₅⊂S₅). Both embed in Bring's Σ₄ (genus ≤ 4), they are distinct, and the ambient Aut(B)=S₅ links them — two torus knots in one Σ₄, NOT one fibre with two symmetries (corrects the earlier conflation). The quadratic Gauss sum over the cinquefoil's ℤ₅-orbit, g=Σζ₅^(k²), satisfies g²=5 (p=5≡1 mod 4 ⇒ g=√5) — the unique source of ζ₅'s irrationality, carried by w₁; so the H₂S chiral residue's irrational scale is √5 and its Bring constant is 1/√5. Exact ζ₅-residue normalisation = 1/√5 remains the conjecture's open monodromy step.

data.finding: The H₂S Bring 1/√5 geometry: the chiral channel is the trefoil T_(2,3) (genus 1) and the ζ₅ carrier is the cinquefoil T_(2,5) (genus 2); both embed in Bring's Σ₄ (genus ≤ 4), they are distinct, and Aut(B)=S₅ links them — two torus knots in one Σ₄. The quintic embeds via the w₁ Lagrange resolvent of ℤ₅⊂S₅; the ℤ₅-orbit Gauss sum satisfies g²=5 (g=√5), the unique irrationality of ζ₅. So the chiral residue's irrational scale is √5 and the Bring constant is 1/√5. The exact ζ₅-residue normalisation (=1/√5) is the conjecture's open monodromy computation.
